body:
Parent epic: #229

## Objective

Create a reproducible, apples-to-apples resource and timing baseline for the current `KL_pp_shadow` implementation before architectural optimization begins.

## Scope

- [ ] Synthesize the current head with Vivado for the shipping 1×1 shape.
- [ ] Synthesize the same head with Vivado for the supported 8×8 shape.
- [ ] Use the target part, 100 MHz constraint, parameters, defines, and source set from the integrated build.
- [ ] Capture hierarchical LUT, FF, RAMB18, RAMB36, DSP, carry, and WNS figures.
- [ ] Capture an integrated pre- and post-substitution comparison.
- [ ] Run Yosys with equivalent geometry and explain significant mapping differences.
- [ ] Check in or document the exact commands and generated report locations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean checkout can reproduce both Vivado OOC configurations.
- [ ] Reports identify the dominant resource consumers by hierarchy.
- [ ] Standalone, integrated, Vivado, and Yosys numbers are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] The baseline is linked from #229 and becomes the reference for the remaining optimization tickets.
title: [Optimisation] Establish authoritative KL_pp_shadow 1×1 and 8×8 area baselines
